narration: In month {fork_month} a bank offered you a card you had not applied for, and you chose {real_choice} where the ghost chose {ghost_choice}. By the close of month {first_bar_apart_month}, {first_bar_apart} had already parted between the two lives. The ghost's money touched its low in month {ghost_lowest_month}, and it stayed above yours for {ghost_ahead_months} months. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. The money was furthest apart in month {widest_gap_month}, the last month, and there the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. With no pay coming in, the ghost could also have held on a little longer, its Safety {safety_gap}.
